reply_text:
*Two merge blockers* in `slug-validation` vs `main`:

1. *The validator accepts partial matches* — `src/validate.js:1–4`
   `Hello`, `hello/world`, `../admin`, spaces and trailing newlines all pass if they contain any allowed substring. `pagePath` consequently accepts them; URL encoding doesn’t enforce the slug contract.
   *Fix:* Require the entire string to match, including strict end-of-input handling (JavaScript’s `$` can match before a final newline). Add rejection tests for these cases.

2. *Reserved slugs aren’t enforced* — `src/route.js:4`
   `isReserved` is never called by the validator or route. All four reserved names produce page URLs—for example, `pagePath('admin')` returns `/p/admin`—contrary to the README.
   *Fix:* Wire the reserved-name check into page validation and test that `pagePath` rejects `new`, `edit`, `admin` and `api`.

All 4 existing tests pass; I reproduced both issues directly. No code changed.
